notes.title: Release 1.35: Immunity frames, tutorial messages, controller support and more
notes.content:
[h2]Immunity frames[/h2]
The question about how the game handles immunity frames have been a much discussed point since the existence of Delta Light. Many people even thought the game had no immunity frames at all. 

The initial way the game handles frames is not on the character like most games, but on the things that can cause damage to the character. So the same mob could only damage the player once every once in a while. This meant however that mobs that shoot bullets like the Pulser could do so while you where in contact with the Pulser itelf. Meaning the player would instantly lose 1 health from the Pulser and up to 4 health for every bullet.

This system is now changed to the more conventional way of handling immunity frames. After the character gets hit and loses health (or a melon slice) they are immune to further damage for half a second. Reducing the chance of insta deaths by Pulsers and the like.


[h2]More tutorial messages[/h2]
Some of the more early levels - pre first boss - have new shiny text boxes displaying on the level select screen. This should clean up a bit of confusion some players had playing the game for the first time. It's not much, but it's honest work.


[h2]Improved controller support[/h2]
When using a controller, the menu items could only be moved using the up and down keys with the d-pad and thumbstick even when the items where positioned horizontally next to one another. This didn't make much sence so it got changed to also include left and right buttons/movement on the menu screen's.

Additionaly you can now turn speedrun timers on and off with the left shoulder and skip the currently playing track with the right shoulder.


[h2]Speedrun timers[/h2]
The speedrun timers were a bit long and got in the way after playing a couple of segments. This could cause the player to lose view on the game window itself. Now only the last 4 segments, the current segment and the total time is shown. This should reduce use screen real estate by at least half.


[h2]Made the game run better[/h2]
Not only has the game's dotnet version been upped, the engine now also has some render improvements. Mostly things to do with the text renderer. Hope to give ya'll a few more FPS this patch.


[h2]Version on home page[/h2]
To more easily see what version of the game is currently running, a patch number is added on the home screen. If you play this patch it should say 'v1.35'.

notes.title: Release 1.3 - Summer Patch 2021
notes.content:
This patch contains lots of changes around the main gameplay and doesn't focus on adding new characters or items. Instead we have looked at performance of the engine and adding/reordering things outside of the main game loop.
[h2]Statistics[/h2]
Ever wondered how many mobs you defeated or how many pickups you picked up? We have a tracking mechanism to the game where we can track all sorts of stuff, and we compiled everything we track in the new statistic page (accessible from the main menu)! 
[h2]Bestiary[/h2]
Believe it or not, there is some lore that surrounds the game. But that doesn't really shine through in the game right now. To introduce you all to a bit of the lore, we created a bestiary containing five maps. One for each basic mob type! Each map contains writing about the specific mob in question (Also accessible from the main menu).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38895143/52e5c210a77cc08c9276b2088d621e60f28504da.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38895143/38a5a38040830c986b41d63b5fcb350b16386df3.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38895143/862eb50a73b0d9817069026c549ad9ae78b99814.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38895143/df306ee1c67fe1d6911a62ac5f9b8f3c19e8623f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38895143/f5a9bef2eac9d970cc6fdcdcb89e9b3b085c12ba.png[/img]
[h2]Performance[/h2]
Pushing the custom engine to go beyond anything it could do just a couple months ago should give players (especialy using weirder setups) a more smooth and streamlined experience. Because we use a custom engine, the work on it was slow but steady and I hope we can deliver an even smoother experience in the future. We are hopeful to continue development on Delta Light and it's engine :heart:
[h2][url=https://discord.gg/s2RPquerdT]Discord[/url][/h2]
We launched a discord for FlapBox studios. Here we want to start building a friendly community for all our (existing and upcoming) games. Here we want to support streamers, give away keys, talk about all kinds of topics and we would love to make a home-brewed levels section in delta light in the future. To create this we NEED input from our players.

Hope you all enjoy the patch <3
See you in the future

~ Veldin

notes.title: Release 1.2 - Spring Patch 2021
notes.content:
We got lots of feedback on the game in the half a year it's been out! Thank you all so much <3 Now on to some of the problems. 
[h2]Movement Speed increase for everyone[/h2]
Some of the characters velt extremely slow, especially considering the passives didn't always made up for the los of speed. Across the whole lineup the movement speed is increased, but especialy for the slowest of the bunch.
[h2]Cost reduction across the board[/h2]
The cost of all the characters are also reduced across the board to allow players to have more characters earlier in the game. We saw that a good majoraty of the players bought Druid and finished the game before trying anyting else.
[h2]Marcoh[/h2]
Marcoh is considered the hardest to unlock, but also changes the game up the most from the other characters. His effect felt a bit slow and unwealdy, so the BloodGems now trigger way more often -every 3.5 seconds from 10 seconds before- and the effect last 4 seconds up from 2.4. Now it's easyer to juggle multiple Blood Gem stacks at the time at the cost of losing more health more frequent.
[h2]New pickup; Lightning Bolt[/h2]
A new pickup as been added; the Lightning Bolt. When you pick this bolt of light up it shocks all mobs on the screen and shrinks them for 4 seconds and reduce their speed. Picking up more shrinks enemies even further while they grind to a halt. (If you shrink them anough they disapear, but the pickup is pretty rare ;))
[h2]More pickup time[/h2]
The other pickups also have their time increased to 4 seconds. Picking them up gave you only a small window before which could go to waste while you were just lining yourself up to use them. So time increase aross the board!
[h2]Renamed infinite mode[/h2]
Infinite mode is renamed to arcade mode, although it is infinite the word 'arcade' seems a bit more fitting <3
[h2]Details:[/h2]
Cherry, Banana and Pineaple:
Effect lasted 2.5 seconds, increased to 4 seconds.

[b]Delta:[/b]
Speed increased from 175 to 195.

[b]Druid[/b]
Speed increased from 175 to 195.
Reduced cost from 25| 5| 2 to 15| 5| 2.

[b]Melon[/b]
Speed increased from 150 to 175.
Reduced cost from 15|25| 2 to 10|10| 2.

[b]Scout[/b]
Speed increased from 110 to 150.
Reduced cost from 30| 4| 2 to 20| 2| 2.

[b]Echo / Answer[/b]
Speed increased from 175 to 195.
Reduced cost from 6 |30| 3 to  3|15| 3.

[b]Eve[/b]
Speed increased from 150 to 175.
Reduced cost from 30|10| 3 to 15| 5| 3.

[b]Speedup[/b]
Speed increased from 150 to 175.
Max also icreased by 25.

[b]magnet[/b]
Speed increased from 175 to 195.

[b]Shock[/b]
Speed increased from 175 to 195.

[b]Marcoh[/b]
Speed increased from 100 to 125.
BloodGem spawn time from 10 seconds to 3.5 seconds
BloodGem effect lasted 2.4 seconds, increased to 4 seconds.

[b]Dryad[/b]
Speed increased from 175 to 195.
Her cost where already reduced in pre release ;)

notes.title: Release 1.1 - Winter Patch 2020
notes.content:
Hey hey, we have been hard at work on Delta Light and we have some stuff we would love to show that was added in this patch. The big things are the introduction of our first new character Dryad, a remake of the infinite mode, balance to some existing characters and some more small changes.

[h2]Introducing Dryad[/h2]
Roaming the great outdoors of the information superhighway is Dryad. They are the first new character added to Delta Light. Their effect allows them to enchant fruit just like Druid does but instead of a temporary boost to the effect, Dryad keeps a portion of the pickup effect for the remainder of the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38895143/f1caa5b3f573f1d04244c312711369f35fa31f23.png[/img]

[h2]Infinite Mode remake[/h2]
Although the infinite mode did what it said on the tin we weren't happy with the variance in experiences it could offer. To help infinite mode stay fresh we added 'Affixes' to the mode. Affixes are stackable effects that randomly occur on the map ranging from a rain of pickups or the addition of huge enemies to a targeted speedup effect or having the map regenerat. The chance these effects occur increase with the brackets just like the overall difficulty of the map. Multiple different and duplicate affixes can spawn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38895143/6dba72bd91c8f5e7281182e8acbb2ac973102898.png[/img]

[h2]Champion updates[/h2]
Almost all characters got minor updates that should make them feel all more in line with eachother. Melon got the biggest update of the bunch with some fresh new effects. When Melon picks up a melon slice he now becoms even bigger and gets a speedup based on how much slices he has. The more melons Melon picks up the longer and effective the boost. This combined with health pickups giving him two melon slices should get him to be a healthy pick!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38895143/f22acbd566fe393ed88c3a56e0f5138cbedacb5b.png[/img]

[h2]Other things[/h2]
We also added some quality of life improvements into the game with this patch.
[list]
[*] Some campaign maps got updates.
[*] New players automaticly unlock Delta.
[*] New text effects on loading a map in level editor.
[*] Updated visuals and particle effects.
[*] Lots of performance fixes.
[*] sharing a map string a bit shorter (but still WIP).
[/list]

notes.title: release 1.02 - 1.05
notes.content:
Hey hey, this is the first patch note I get to write after releasing the game and I would like to open with a thanks to everyone that played the game <3 It was amazing to see people to react on the release, the levels, the BOSSES, and all the posts and comments. Thanks.
[h2]Victory Screen[/h2]
Seeing the game being played by more people allowed me to see some things that we missed and could clarify ingame. One thing was a proper Victory Screen. The game waits for you to press enter after each level, this allows you to just sit and look at the map you just finished or chill to the music. But it was not clear the game was waiting for an input. So we added the victory screen to fix that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38895143/7b445cf1652ddcc0ffdcbc34019cbedbf812d6e0.png[/img] 
[h2]lag issues / stuttering[/h2]
Other gripe that users reported is that the game can be quite laggy, causing mobs to go outside the map and destroy himself and also causing lines to not finish properly. We implemented some ways of balancing more of the CPU load over the same amount of time. This should make sure that CPU load doesn't spike and stops the feelings of stuttering. This fix is live right now!

For advanced users we have added control to this mechanism inside the options.ini file. This file is located at "%AppData%\Roaming\FlapBox\DeltaLight\options.ini". In this file a value is assigned to the key 
"loopDivider" (defaulty the value is 8). Setting the value higher is going to let the engine try and smooth the load further, possible decreasing spikes. Setting the number too high might cause slowdowns.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38895143/838d1d2c957fd246b3b75eb5bd29dc2dd34a31a6.png[/img]
[h2]Future![/h2]
We have some plans for the future. I would like to use this note to reveal an feature where we can show used designed maps directly in the client. Right now we are working behind the scenes to implement it. This together with some big updates to the level editor in the future [i](and new characters are in the works also!)[/i]

Thanks again everyone for your feedback!
[url=https://twitter.com/V3ldin]Veldin[/url]~
